fieldValues.title: srs-rust#1041 (ADR-045 caller list + FileStore meta roundtrip test) is already resolved on master, unclosed
fieldValues.summary: srs-rust#1041 asked for two hardening fixes: document ADR-045's two undocumented load_container_for_repair read callers (manifest_service::unset_manifest_root_container, doctor_service::instance_id_referenced), and add a FileStore-backed roundtrip test for the meta-persistence fix landed in #1034. Both are already done and merged into master via PR #1042 (commit 0f388af, merged 2026-09-11T08:46:10Z) -- the coordinator dispatched it again at 22:16Z the same day because the PR body used 'Refs #1041' instead of 'Closes #1041', so the merge never auto-closed the issue and it stayed visible in gate:pool/gate:dispatched.
evidence: docs/adr/045-membership-removal-is-a-repair-operation.md Consequences section already names both callers (verified by direct read on this session's fresh origin/master checkout, HEAD 54f9cb4)
CLAUDE.md's mirrored caller-list summary line already matches

crates/srs-repository/tests/record_meta_persistence.rs exists on master and its single test (file_store_update_record_persists_meta_round_trip) passes: `cargo test -p srs-repository --test record_meta_persistence` -> 1 passed; 0 failed

git log -- CLAUDE.md and the ADR file both show 0f388af as the tip-touching commit, titled '...(#1041)', merged via PR #1042 which used 'Refs #1041' rather than 'Closes #1041' (pull_request_read on PR #1042: merged:true, merged_at 2026-09-11T08:46:10Z, body ends 'Refs #1041')
fieldValues.body: Same failure shape as finding ff40c690 (srs#427): a PR that fixes an issue but references it with 'Refs' instead of 'Closes' leaves the issue open and eligible for re-dispatch, wasting a future worker's claim on work that is already done. The fix for the coordinator/dispatch side is process, not code: prefer 'Closes #N' over 'Refs #N' whenever the PR's own change is the issue's complete fix (CLAUDE.md's Branch & PR hygiene section already states this rule for merged-branch tracking; the gap here is that the same rule protects against exactly this false-open state, and dispatch does not currently check gate:pool candidates against already-merged fixes before pulling one).
